vivo.step_3: In Settings > Apps > "Autostart", turn GO on if your phone has it.

setup.card: Make a new key on the card
setup.card_hint: Only the card knows this key. If you lose the card, the QORT on it is lost.

switch.done: Done. The card now has a key GO can restore, and a new address. Don't send anything to the old address.
switch.dust: {{amount}} QORT is less than the fee to move it, so it stays with the old key.
switch.has_name: This card has the name {{name}} on chain, which belongs to its current key. Switching would leave the name behind, so it cannot switch.
switch.how: To get a card you can back up, give it a key GO can restore. GO makes it from your wallet just for this card: it is not your main account's key, and the card gets a new address of its own. GO moves the card's QORT back first, then loads the new key.
switch.move_first: First GO moves {{amount}} QORT back to your account (fee {{fee}} QORT). You hold the card to the phone to sign.
switch.not_empty: The old address still holds {{amount}} QORT. Move it back first.
switch.ready: The old address is empty. Hold the card to the phone to load the new key.
switch.title: Switch to a key GO can restore
switch.waiting: Waiting for the move back to confirm, about a minute…

qortal_card.testing_note: Testing only. Test cards have no PIN yet, so anyone holding one can pay with it. Keep only a few QORT on a card.

gate.background_hint: You can minimize this window: the download carries on, and you can follow it in notifications.
gate.disclaimer: Qortino can be confidently wrong → double-check anything important.
gate.intro: Your offline companion for first aid and health, survival and prepping, gardening, cooking, Qortal and much more. Assembled once from QDN onto this phone, then it works without any internet. No cloud, nothing leaves your phone.
gate.low_ram: This phone has {{ram}} of memory. Qortino will work, but answers may be slow and Android may close it while it runs in the background.
gate.low_storage: Not enough free space: Qortino needs {{needed}}, and this phone has {{free}} free.
gate.model_blurb: One smart model for everyday questions, emergencies and Qortal help. Runs fully on this phone.
gate.new_model: Qortino has a new, smarter brain. Assemble it once; the old Lite and Standard packs are deleted to free their space.
gate.public_node_body: The public node is shared and not reliable for a {{size}} download: it can stop part way or drop what it already fetched. GO keeps trying by itself and keeps what arrived, but your own node is much faster and steadier.
gate.public_node_title: A private node is highly recommended
